name: The Balls Brothers
caption: Big B Bob and Little B Joe, who won the CWWF Television Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell' on 1 November 1996.

tenures.note: Won the CWWF Television Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell' (1 Nov 1996).

name: More Ice
caption: JC Ice and Hugh Morris's own tag pairing, losing the CWWF Television Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell' before turning on each other in the aftermath.

tenures.note: Lost the CWWF Television Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell', the partners turning on each other in the aftermath.

name: MC Masters
caption: A unit billed by CWWF in the surviving 1997 Usenet record.

tenures.note: Unsuccessfully challenged for the CWWF World Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell'.

name: The Crusher
caption: Big Poppa and The Pimp, who retained the CWWF World Tag Team Championship against MC Masters at 'Nite of Living Hell,' the only such reign this corpus attests.

tenures.note: Retained the CWWF World Tag Team Championship at 'Nite of Living Hell'.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; no identity join is asserted (bare-name match is insufficient)
